summary: Regression test after Security Audit fixes (SEC-001..004 + Google OAuth hardening). Focus on frontend flows: admin login, campaign toggle/publish, plans checkout, and protected route redirect. All primary flows PASS. Admin login redirects to /dashboard; campaign toggle & publish return 200 with correct toasts; Stripe checkout opens successfully from Plans page for an authenticated user (no 401/500). Protected route /dashboard correctly redirects to /login when unauthenticated.

issues: Recharts warning: ResponsiveContainer width/height computed as -1 on initial render (cosmetic, chart renders correctly afterwards)

critical_code_review_comments: Security fixes verified end-to-end from UI: /api/campaigns/{id}/status (Pydantic body) returns 200; /api/payments/checkout returns valid Stripe URL when authenticated via cookie (withCredentials).
Minor: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings; consider setting explicit min-height on chart container.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security regression complete.
